title: igris history --stats --json
description: Plan health over the runs in the log: per rank, and the tasks that are candidates for a rewrite.

v.description: Document version. Changes only with a breaking change (igris 2.0); fields may be added in 1.x, and readers ignore fields they don't know.

runs.description: Runs read: all of them, or the last N with -n.

ranks.description: One entry per rank, in order of first appearance. A task still running and a user task take no part.

rewrite.description: Tasks with 2 or more attempts, or a verify failure, in every run that ran them; most attempts first.

tasks.description: Task runs: a task that ran in two runs counts twice.

attempts.description: Mean attempts per task run, retries included.

verify_fail_rate.description: From 0 to 1: verify_failed over verify_runs; left out when verify never ran.

agent_s.description: Mean agent time per task run, over the runs that record times (since 1.8); left out when none does.

needs_you_s.description: Mean time waiting on the owner per task run; as agent_s.

rank.description: The rank of the task's newest run.
